summary: Frontend-only E2E pass over the 'Premium in-app experience' UX plan checkpoints on The Dev Store (owner brand 1). Tested at 390x844, 768x1024 and 1920x1080 in light and dark. All 14 target routes rendered with NO horizontal overflow, NO raw i18n keys, NO console errors and NO hydration warnings across all viewport/theme combinations. Deep interaction tests covered checkpoints 2.2, 2.3, 2.4, 2.5, 2.6, 3.4, 3.7, 3.9, 3.10 and B-block (wallet reveal, developers, referrals). ONE disposable payment link 'QA-DISPOSABLE-1788998054' at $1 USD was created on The Dev Store per the write budget (success modal did render). Two concrete defects were found; everything else passes.

ui_bugs.issue: paylink-detail-copy button does NOT set data-copied="true" after being clicked. Its visible text does flip to 'Copied ✓' but the automation contract in the spec (and the equivalent success-modal copy button) is data-copied=true. Reproduction: /pay-links → click any paylink-view-<id> → click [data-testid=paylink-detail-copy] → inspect element: only class/tabindex/type/data-testid attributes, no data-copied. This means tests that assert data-copied=true will fail even though the copy actually happened.

mobile-preview-summary testid is missing from the DOM at 390 AND 768. mobile-preview-section and mobile-preview-toggle are present, but the summary node showing the live amount (per spec 'mobile-preview-summary (live amount)') is not rendered — neither collapsed nor after clicking mobile-preview-toggle to expand.

issues: preview-standard-total renders 'currency symbol + amount + currency code' without a separator between the amount and the ISO code (innerText is '$1.00USD'). If this is two adjacent spans, add a hairline space or a visible gap so it doesn't read as one token.

action_items: Add data-copied="true" (and reset back to "false" after the timeout) to [data-testid=paylink-detail-copy] in Components/Page/Payment-link/PaymentLinkDetailPanel.tsx — the equivalent flag already works on the success-modal copy button.

Emit the mobile-preview-summary testid inside mobile-preview-section on /create-pay-link (Components/Page/CreatePaymentLink/index.tsx) — show the live amount (and currency) so mobile users can see it without expanding the collapsible.
Add whitespace/gap between the amount and the currency code in preview-standard-total on LivePreviewPanel.
critical_code_review_comments: Both /create-pay-link and mobile checkout preview always mount the desktop-preview-pane subtree in the DOM (display:none at <lg) and always mount the mobile-preview-section subtree (display:none at >=lg). This is not a bug (offsetParent is null at the wrong viewport), but note that automated 'element must not exist' assertions will fail — use visibility/getBoundingClientRect rather than exists checks.

paylink-detail-copy and paylink-success-copy-btn are two separate implementations of the same pattern; they diverge on whether data-copied is set. Extract a shared CopyButton with a single a11y/testid contract to avoid future drift.

Do NOT rely on role='switch' for the settings notifications preferences — those checkboxes are plain <input type=checkbox> with no role/aria-label/testid. Add data-testids per preference so they are testable without positional selectors.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (12/14 checkpoints pass fully; 2 partial due to the two defects above)
